name: units
title: Unit conversions into the analyte SI unit
description: value in FROM_UNIT x FACTOR = value in TO_UNIT. TO_UNIT is always the analyte's UNIT_SI; the reverse conversion is 1 / FACTOR. Factors are test-specific (the same unit string converts differently for different analytes, and G/L means giga per litre for counts but grams per litre for proteins). Unit spellings are matched after normalisation by the loaders.

fields.name: FROM_UNIT
fields.description: Unit as it may arrive on a record
